card.title: How many results should each Search group show?
card.about: Rows per Search group on the results screen.
card.context:
Search shows results in groups.
A longer group pushes the next group off the phone screen.

options.label: A. Three rows
options.cost: More taps to see the rest.
pros: Fits a phone with the keyboard open

options.label: B. Five rows
options.why: Five fits the screen with room for the keyboard.

options.label: C. Eight rows
options.risk: Pushes later groups off the screen.

card.pick_why: Five rows is the most that still leaves the keyboard room.
card.skip: If you skip this, Search keeps showing five rows.
words: the set of results of one kind

document.title: How many results should each Search group show?
